name: Xia Su
tagline: AI that bridges people and spaces.
profile: I study how AI can help people understand, navigate, and shape the spaces around them. My work connects architecture, human-computer interaction, accessibility, and computer vision. At Google, I explore how vision algorithms and AI agents can work across devices and the cloud to understand environments, human behavior, and the relationships between them.

bullets: Research collaborative on-device and cloud deployment of computer vision algorithms and AI agents under resource constraints.
Explore multi-level understanding of spaces and human behavior, connecting environmental context with how people interact with their surroundings.
Investigate context-sensitive safety-risk alerts that respond to user needs and available computational resources.

education.detail:
Doctoral research, Computer Science & Engineering; dissertation defended Aug 2026.
M.S., Computer Science & Engineering, 2024. Advisor: Jon E. Froehlich.

Bachelor of Architecture, 2014 - 2018; master's degree, 2018 - 2021.
Research in architecture, computational design, and indoor scene generation.

skills: Dense prediction and segmentation; visual SLAM; structure from motion; 3D reconstruction and scene synthesis; mobile AR; CAD and fabrication.
PyTorch; transformers and ViTs; SFT, PEFT, and GRPO; RAG; agent workflows; LangGraph; Model Context Protocol; custom objectives and evaluation.
Full-stack web development; cross-platform mobile/AR applications; robotics and embedded integration; real-time graphics; UI/UX design.
Benchmark and dataset design; data curation; quantitative and qualitative analysis; human-centered AI; user studies and statistical analysis.
